notes.title: Game Updates
notes.content:
Update notice
1. Added new SP skins for Beaumont and Meryl
2. Added "collectibles" gameplay (whole team gain)
3. Added "race tower" gameplay (limited race tower climbing, main product breakthrough)
4. After adding 5 heroes into the new "Altar of Destiny", the lowest synchronization level among them will be given to all other heroes.
5. Added "continuous breakthrough" gameplay (producing collectibles, breakthrough stones)
6. The drop rate of gems in the corridor is appropriately increased.
